description: Building Permits is a dataset listed in City of Melbourne open data portal (data.melbourne.vic.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by data.melbourne.vic.gov.au. This public register of building permits lists all building permits for building works issued by Melbourne Certification Group, in and outside of the City of Melbourne, and also any building works issued by Private Building Surveyors within the City of Melbourne. ​The information provided is extracted from the records held by City of Melbourne. Coverage: City of Melbourne, Australia. The portal files it under the publisher data.melbourne.vic.gov.au. Its tags are building, permits, planning, accessibility, cityreactivation. It offers 3 resource(s) in csv, json. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-melbourne-vic-gov-au-portal.
